limits: two labelled sessions, one speaker, one room, one lighting state
the temporal split is over a ~20 s window, so train and test are highly correlated in time
leave-one-session-out is reported but with two sessions it means training on one class only for a binary task, so it is a sanity check, not a measurement
no error bars; one number from one split
this validates the PIPELINE and the CONTROLS. It is not evidence that the task is solved.
